navNotes: Not in src/modules/nav.ts; the App layout puts "Benachrichtigungen" (InboxIcon) in the sidebar top group under Start, with the unread count as a badge (also on the phone menu tile). Also reached via the Home inbox card.

pages.title: Benachrichtigungen
pages.purpose: Personal inbox across all of the person's orgs (and platform events for platform admins); open one, mark all read.

sections.title: Alle · Ungelesen
sections.notes: Hand-made segmented links (not <Segments>), right-aligned above the table.

actions.label: (row)
actions.result: marks read, switches the active org to the notification's org, redirects to the event's href (or back to /notifications); prefetch requests are ignored

uxNotes: Opening a notification silently switches the active org – the user lands in another org without a hint.
No link from the inbox to the personal notification preferences (Settings › Profil #notifications) or vice versa.
Filter is a custom segmented control instead of <Segments>; PageHeader uses an icon (app.md: no area icon in PageHeader).
'Alle als gelesen markieren' gives no toast/feedback beyond the badges disappearing.
Notifications cannot be deleted or marked unread individually.
